contracts.identity: local_identity::refine(program:&Program, storage:&[(Reg,usize)])->Option<LocalIdentities>. Clone Debug. .group(Reg)->Option<usize>, .groups()->usize. Exactly supplied distinct valid registers; result dense deterministic labels; each result group SUBSET of exactly one supplied storage color. Never merges different colors. Within each old color, connect destination and RHS source register for copies or arithmetic roots: traverse Binary Add/Mul/And/Or/Xor both operands; Sub/Shl/Shr left only; bare Register. Do NOT traverse Load, Select, comparisons, or arbitrary uses (e.g. a Load address is NOT same value lineage). This is bounded connectivity evidence, not source-variable recovery or full reaching-def webs. Iterate ALL reachable assignments, no expression evaluation/mutation. Global upfront bounded validation before recursive traversal, all-failure None, no deps. Inputs invalid/out-of-range/duplicate or budget exhaustion reject whole pass. Bound register subset4096, instruction+assignment points100k, total expressions/work, depth128 or similarly explicit. Include whole-input depth validation even memory destinations / excluded regs to avoid resource bypass.
